args.prompt:
Create a native game sprite atlas with EXACTLY THIRTY-TWO NEW complete full-body drawings of ONE named adult character, FOUR equal columns by EIGHT full rows on a tall portrait transparent RGBA canvas. Detailed crisp pixel-art adult proportions, same character and outfit in every cell. No text, numbers, grid, borders, scenery, painted floor or cast-shadow disks. Every body AND all held equipment has generous12–15% transparent cell margins: complete hair, hands, arms, legs, boot soles and weapon tips; never crop last-row feet. Same shared BODY DRAWING SCALE throughout the source; crouches/kneels remain naturally shorter, not inflated. Side/three-quarter facing RIGHT.
IDENTITY/VERSION: ARTHUR PENDRAGON from KAAMELOTT LivreIII television2005, adult white man, SHORT dark brown slightly curly hair and SHORT neat dark beard/moustache. RED-BROWN LEATHER CUIRASS over BURGUNDY tunic, GREY CHAINMAIL sleeves, dark brown trousers, brown leather belt and LEFT-HIP SCABBARD, brown leather boots, dark brown cape with DISCREET collar, a THIN simple GOLD CIRCLET, never a huge crown or long dark mane. Natural human king, not black fantasy armor.
EQUIPMENT/ROLE: EXCALIBUR is a real straight STEEL SWORD with simple GOLD crossguard and brown grip, correctly held in one right hand or both hands. No energy blade, laser, giant painted slash, summoned stone or magical shout. Whole sword fits inside every cell; calm phases may place it in the left-hip scabbard.
No old image is supplied: the inspected previous atlas had incorrect equipment/identity. Follow this exact written identity.
EIGHT DISTINCT STORYBOARD ROWS, FOUR anatomical poses each, top to bottom:
ROW 1: INTRO (1) stand with Excalibur sheathed and tired thoughtful expression, (2) adjust belt with free hand, (3) draw whole steel sword slowly, (4) balanced modest sword guard.
ROW 2: OUTRO (1) lower sword, (2) wipe brow with free forearm while blade points safely down, (3) sheath sword in left-hip scabbard, (4) turn away with a restrained open-hand signal.
ROW 3: ROUND VICTORY (1) lower blade and exhale, (2) small weary sideways glance, (3) adjust belt with free hand, (4) resume compact physical guard.
ROW 4: ROUND DEFEAT alive and regrouping: (1) recoil with free forearm guarding and knees bent, (2) low bent-knee crouch with equipment safely controlled, (3) one knee down with head lowered and free hand bracing if available, (4) rise halfway looking toward fight. No injury, blood, death or lost equipment.
ROW 5: FINALE ADAPTATION Physical non-gory sword conclusion: (1) sword low and hips coiled, (2) draw blade diagonally back with front foot planted, (3) a real controlled diagonal cut RIGHT with different knees/hips, (4) recover and lower whole blade. No victim, execution, light beam or magic.
ROW 6: MATCH VICTORY (1) lower blade, (2) sheath Excalibur safely, (3) modest tired nod with one hand on belt, (4) turn away with relaxed shoulders.
ROW 7: MATCH DEFEAT alive fatigue: (1) shoulders sag with equipment safely down, (2) sink to one knee with free palm on thigh if available, (3) rest on heel head lowered with all held objects still physically supported, (4) lift head and brace to rise, both complete feet visible. No corpse, wounds, blood or dropped/disconnected anatomy.
ROW 8: SUPER Passe d’armes à Excalibur: (1) low sword guard, (2) lift whole blade into a high diagonal preparation with front knee bent, (3) follow through a PHYSICAL cut RIGHT with hips and shoulders turned, (4) retract to a lower two-foot guard. No projectile or large painted slash.
Final check: EIGHT full rows x FOUR complete bodies=32. Four distinct shoulder/elbow/torso/leg drawings per row, not glow-only recolors. Physical weapon emitters point RIGHT in aiming/recoil columns2 and3 of damaging super/finale rows; columns1 and4 are lowered preparation/recovery with no emission. Support actions never fire weapons. Long beams, projectiles, magical barriers and target explosions belong to runtime, never paint them across body cells. No victim, gore, execution, injured body, transformation or extra person.
